title: Keto-friendly Bhuna Shredded Coconut Pilaf
description: A flavorful and nutritious meal-prep dish featuring shredded coconut in a spicy garlic sauce, perfect for those following a keto diet.
instructions: In a large pot, heat vegetable oil over medium-high heat.
Add garlic powder and turmeric powder, sautéing for about 1 minute.
Stir in red pepper flakes (adjust to taste).
Pour coconut milk and chicken broth into the pot. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, add salt and cumin powder, stir well until combined.
Gradually stir in shredded coconut, continuing to cook for about 10 minutes or until thickened slightly but still loose enough to eat with your hands.
Stir in lemon juice just before serving. Garnish with fresh basil leaves if desired.
Serve hot as a side dish or over rice for a complete meal.
